# Posnic Open Source POS Guides

> Practical, source-linked guidance for evaluating and operating Posnic, an offline-first open source POS and billing software project for retail shops and restaurants.

Posnic supports local Offline POS workflows and self-hosted or optional Online/Offline POS deployments. Posnic-owned source is AGPL-3.0-only; release packages contain separately licensed components documented by the project. Do not infer compatibility with a specific peripheral without checking the versioned hardware evidence and testing the exact device.

## Official Posnic resources

- [Posnic website](https://www.posnic.com/): Canonical product website.
- [Posnic/POS source](https://github.com/Posnic/POS): Public source, releases, issues, and project documentation.
- [User guide](https://github.com/Posnic/POS/blob/develop/docs/USER_GUIDE.md): Setup and operating workflows.
- [Self-hosting guide](https://github.com/Posnic/POS/blob/develop/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md): Server installation, security, backup, and maintenance boundaries.
- [Hardware matrix](https://github.com/Posnic/POS/blob/develop/docs/HARDWARE_MATRIX.md): Implemented interfaces and device-specific evidence.
- [Retail POS go-live checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-go-live-checklist.html): Acceptance checks for transactions, hardware, offline operation, synchronization, backups, and rollback.
- [Retail POS data migration checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-data-migration-checklist.md): Source-data preservation, mapping, import testing, cutover, and reconciliation checks.
- [Restaurant POS opening and closing checklist](https://posnic.github.io/restaurant-pos-opening-closing-checklist.md): Shift controls for tills, menus, printers, offline operation, cash reconciliation, and handover.
- [Retail POS inventory cycle count checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-inventory-cycle-count-checklist.md): Stock cutoffs, blind counts, offline synchronization, variance investigation, approvals, and audit evidence.
- [Retail POS end-of-day cash reconciliation checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-end-of-day-cash-reconciliation-checklist.md): Till cutoffs, tender reconciliation, offline synchronization, variance investigation, approval, and shift handover.
- [Retail POS incident response checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-incident-response-checklist.md): Outage containment, controlled fallback, duplicate prevention, recovery, reconciliation, and retained evidence.
- [Retail POS receipt printer troubleshooting](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-receipt-printer-troubleshooting.md): Transaction protection, printer and cash-drawer fault isolation, safe recovery, and duplicate prevention.
- [Retail POS cash drawer troubleshooting](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-cash-drawer-troubleshooting.md): Transaction protection, drawer and printer-path fault isolation, authorization checks, and cash reconciliation.
- [Retail POS barcode scanner troubleshooting](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-barcode-scanner-troubleshooting.md): Label, scanner, input, catalog, and lookup diagnosis with offline and duplicate-scan controls.
- [Retail POS user access review checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-user-access-review-checklist.md): Staff roles, sensitive actions, leavers, offline enforcement, integrations, exceptions, and retained evidence.
- [Retail POS returns, refunds, and voids checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-returns-refunds-voids-checklist.md): Original-sale checks, approval, payment reversal, inventory disposition, offline synchronization, and reconciliation.
- [Retail POS discount and promotion testing checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-discount-promotion-testing-checklist.md): Coupons, price rules, boundary tests, stacking, receipts, offline behavior, synchronization, and rollout controls.
- [Retail POS tax and invoice testing checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-tax-invoice-testing-checklist.md): Tax rates, classifications, pricing basis, rounding, receipts, invoices, offline behavior, and synchronization checks.

## Evaluation guides

- [Offline POS vs Online/Offline POS](https://posnic.github.io/offline-vs-online-pos.md): Deployment and failure-mode comparison.
- [Offline POS backup checklist](https://posnic.github.io/offline-pos-backup-checklist.md): Backup and restore verification before production use.
- [Open source POS evaluation checklist](https://posnic.github.io/open-source-pos-evaluation-checklist.md): Source, licensing, offline behavior, hardware, recovery, and maintenance review.
- [Retail POS hardware checklist](https://posnic.github.io/retail-pos-hardware-checklist.md): Markdown checklist for printers, scanners, drawers, scales, displays, payments, and recovery.

## Optional

- [Latest Posnic release](https://github.com/Posnic/POS/releases/latest): Desktop packages and checksums.
- [Release verification](https://github.com/Posnic/POS/blob/develop/docs/VERIFY_RELEASE.md): Package integrity, signatures, provenance, and component-license checks.
- [Community discussions](https://github.com/Posnic/POS/discussions): Questions and project feedback.
